components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact, lime action used for sign-in, sync, and primary recovery paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:10px 18px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-dim); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that keeps the page surface visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:transparent; color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:10px 18px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A pill filter with a clear accent-filled selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip-set { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-chip { background:transparent; color:var(--text-secondary); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); padding:7px 14px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.82rem; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--text-secondary); color:var(--text); } .ds-chip-active { background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Step Card
components.description: A flat instructional surface with a numbered accent marker.

components.css: .ds-step-card { background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--radius-md); padding:24px; font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-step-number { display:grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; margin-bottom:14px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-step-card h3 { margin:0 0 7px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.15; } .ds-step-card p { margin:0; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:.9rem; line-height:1.55; }

components.name: Leaderboard Row
components.description: The signature contribution row: rank, identity, merge count, and right-aligned points.
components.html: 2A@alexyou14 merges840 pts
components.css: .ds-board-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:52px 1fr auto auto; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:14px 20px; background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--border-soft); font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-board-row-you { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, var(--surface-1)); box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); } .ds-rank,.ds-points { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600; } .ds-rank { color:var(--accent); text-align:center; } .ds-person { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-width:0; } .ds-avatar { display:grid; place-items:center; width:34px; height:34px; border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--radius-pill); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text-muted); font-family:var(--font-display); } .ds-you { background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); padding:2px 7px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-merges { color:var(--text-muted); font-size:.82rem; } .ds-points { color:var(--accent); text-align:right; } .ds-points small { color:var(--text-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:400; } @media (max-width:620px) { .ds-board-row { grid-template-columns:38px 1fr auto; gap:12px; padding:12px 14px; } .ds-merges { display:none; } }

components.name: Test Login Notice
components.description: An explicit dashed notice that prevents test authentication from being mistaken for live OAuth.
components.css: .ds-stub-note { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; padding:11px 16px; color:var(--text-secondary); background:var(--surface-1); border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-md); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:.83rem; } .ds-stub-note strong { color:var(--text); font-weight:600; } .ds-stub-dot { flex:0 0 8px; width:8px; height:8px; margin-top:7px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill); background:var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
GitBounty looks like a focused contribution console: dark graphite working surfaces, compact controls, crisp dividers, and a lime signal that makes points and current state legible at a glance. It borrows GitHub's information density without imitating GitHub's chrome. The result should feel practical, technical, and earned rather than game-like or financial.

The same semantic roles switch to a pale, green-cast paper palette when the operating system requests light mode. Both modes preserve the hierarchy: quiet surfaces carry most content, typography does the structural work, and the accent is reserved for actions, scores, progress, selection, and focus. Authentication is still a test harness, so its status must remain explicit wherever it affects a user's interpretation of the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite-first surfaces with an OS-driven light counterpart.
One lime/leaf accent used as a functional signal, not decoration.
Compact square controls, gently rounded containers, and pill-shaped filters or identity tags.
Space Grotesk hierarchy, Inter reading text, and JetBrains Mono for ranks, repositories, handles, and points.
Responsive, readable application layouts with honest loading, empty, error, and test-login states.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Wash Rule
rules.body: Keep the accent concentrated in actions, current state, points, progress, and focus; content surfaces remain neutral.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Author against the shared role variables so OS light mode remains a real equivalent, not a separate visual branch.

rules.name: The Verifiable Value Rule
rules.body: Render points, ranks, repository references, and account handles in mono; prose and actions stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight, spacing, and font family before adding more type sizes; the interface intentionally keeps a tight ramp.

rules.name: The Score Survives Rule
rules.body: Responsive compression may hide secondary merge counts or stack metadata, but the identity, rank, and points remain visible.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal contrast, dividers, and inset state marks for depth; do not add ambient card shadows.

rules.name: The Shape Carries Meaning Rule
rules.body: Use 4px for actions, 8px for surfaces, and full pills only for filters, identity, progress, or small circular markers.

dos: Do bind new surfaces to the semantic color roles so dark and light OS themes stay equivalent.
Do preserve the 1040px reading width, 24px edge padding, and compact 8/12/16/24px rhythm on application routes.
Do keep points, ranks, repositories, and handles in JetBrains Mono while headings use Space Grotesk and prose uses Inter.
Do keep test-login, loading, empty, error, selected, and disabled states visible and accurately labelled.
Do use one-pixel borders and tonal planes before reaching for elevation.
donts: Don't introduce ambient card shadows, large soft radii, or decorative gradients as a new surface language.
Don't use the accent as a broad background wash or for unrelated decoration.
Don't hide rank, identity, or points when responsive layouts compress.
Don't describe the test sign-in as real GitHub authentication.
Don't extend the landing page's existing eyebrow into a reusable kicker pattern; it is a one-off treatment, not a system role.
